explanation: The central tree is reduced from 6,251 to 4,411 characters (29.4%) and from 87 to 58 lines (33.3%). Four peripheral trees expand identity/cache ownership, tree navigation/folding, graph parsing, and interpreter evidence. Modular boundaries distinguish public entry points from private adapters; call order and data dependencies explain computation; ownership distinguishes stored tree nodes from cached derived anchors. Connections attach to specific concept lines, and positions leave gaps around measured text bounds. Corrections clarify two seed claims: asciiTree.ts takes text from node.label, while the first span supplies coordinates; diagramContentNodes.ts scopes legacy node and parent/child IDs, without retaining interpreter edges. Details absent from the seed include object-identity caching, the tree path bypassing deepFreeze, raw-ASCII helpers always using the default tree parser, frame-cell grouping, wire-component source fallback, and explainNode's precise evidence filters. Evidence comes only from the supplied point, six pinned source texts, and seed. identity and folding draw on diagramContent.ts, diagramContentNodes.ts and asciiTree.ts; graph draws on parseAsciiGraph.ts; evidence draws on interpreter/index.ts and types.ts. Imported interpreter-stage implementations and geometry consumers were not supplied, so their internal behavior is not inferred. Selection and endpoint uses are stated by the supplied point; downstream UI behavior is not independently established.
